findings.name: Cinema City

findings.note: StepMania converted pad (not commercial StepManiaX) maps to other. Still listed 2025 with Bad condition.

findings.name: Game Zone - Cinema City Bemowo

findings.note: Converted StepMania on old PIU hardware maps to other (not pump_it_up software, not stepmaniax). Cinema City official Game Zone list includes Bemowo.

findings.name: Hopa Lupa
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: 舞战纪 (Dance Battle); 舞立方·秀 120Hz (DANCE³ Show 120hz) 5 PLN / 3 songs Perfect. Info: Dance^3 and Dance Battle (Chinese DRS clone). Photo Dance³ Show 120 Hz. Updated 2025-03-17.
findings.note: Large indoor park (Nowa Sukcesja, Łódź) with Chinese dance rhythm cabs. Both map to other. hopalupa.fun confirms arcade zone.

findings.name: Masters Billard and Bowling
